title: Net 30 Business Credit
subtitle: Lesson 14 / Vendors and Credit
slides: Vendor credit matters
It builds relationships, manages cash flow, and strengthens the business credit profile.
Net 30 accounts
Purchase goods or services on credit and pay the invoice within 30 days.
Payment history
On-time payments help demonstrate reliability to future lenders.
Use in sequence
Start after the foundation is ready and records match.
Document everything
Track accounts, invoice dates, and proof of payment.

title: Business Bank Account
subtitle: Lesson 7 / Banking Foundation
slides: Financial identity
The business bank account starts the company financial history.
Relationship banking
A local or regional bank may be better for future loan conversations.
Ask before opening
Look for a business banker, credit products, and small-business lending support.
Handle cleanly
Avoid overdrafts, returned items, and inconsistent activity.
Save proof
Keep account documents and statements in the business file.

title: Business Address
subtitle: Lesson 2 / Business Identity
slides: Real business location
The address should support credibility, not just mail handling.
Use legal name
The address should connect to the exact business legal name.
Virtual office rule
Choose a location where you can work or meet a client if needed.
Avoid red flags
P.O. boxes, mailbox stores, and mailbox-only addresses can create approval issues.
Use everywhere
Keep the same verified address on records, banking, directories, and applications.

title: Business Plan
subtitle: Lesson 10 / Banking Foundation
slides: Business plan value
A plan gives lenders a structured view of the company.
Executive summary
Explain the business, goals, and how they will be achieved.
Operations and market
Show how the company works and who it serves.
Financial picture
Use realistic numbers and a clear use of funds.
Professional document
Save a clean plan that matches the website and applications.

title: EIN From IRS
subtitle: Lesson 6 / Legal Setup
slides: EIN means Employer Identification Number
The IRS assigns this federal tax ID to the business.
Business identity
Think of it as a federal ID number for the company.
Banking and records
The EIN connects tax, bank, and vendor information.
Use exact details
The EIN should match the legal business name.
Save the letter
Keep the EIN confirmation with business records.

title: NAV.com and eCredable Fast Track
subtitle: Lesson 15 / Vendors and Credit
slides: Credit profile tools
NAV.com and eCredable help monitor and build profile visibility.
NAV.com
Review personal and business credit signals in one place.
NAV Boost
Monthly payments may help report activity to major bureaus.
eCredable
Certain eligible bills may be reported to support the business file.
Use carefully
Tools help visibility, but they do not replace proper setup.

title: Website and Domain Email
subtitle: Lesson 3 / Business Identity
slides: Website and email work together
A domain, website, and domain email create one business identity signal.
Missing email is a red flag
Personal email can make the business look unfinished or less legitimate.
Use domain email
Use firstname.lastname@yourdomain.com, info@yourdomain.com, or a similar business address.
Provider setup
GoDaddy, Wix, Webflow, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and similar services can help.
Match every record
Website, email, phone, address, and applications should tell the same story.

title: Business Phone Setup
subtitle: Lesson 1A / Business Identity
slides: Business phone number
Lenders may check whether the business has a legitimate phone signal.
FCC and carrier data
The number type can affect how professional the company appears.
Avoid personal-only setup
A dedicated business number supports trust and reliability.
Use consistently
Put the same number on records, website, and applications.
Next step
Add the number to the Business 411 directory.
Choose a qualified provider
If you do not have a business number yet, use one of the vendor options below for proper business phone setup and registration.

title: Business 411 Directory
subtitle: Lesson 1B / Business Identity
slides: Business 411 listing
Make the business easier to verify in directory records.
ListYourself.net
Use the business listing flow to submit your information.
Business information
Fill out the business name, phone number, and address correctly.
Phone verification
Answer the call and enter the PIN shown on screen.
Save confirmation
Keep proof that the number is listed.

title: Revolving Business Credit Cards
subtitle: Lesson 16 / Vendors and Credit
slides: Business card options
Different cards serve different stages of business credit.
Bank cards
Major banks may offer rewards, cash back, and travel benefits.
Retail cards
Store cards can support purchasing with specific vendors.
Approval readiness
Personal credit, business profile, and revenue may matter.
Use responsibly
Control utilization and pay on time after approval.
